children: I-ON Digital’s revenue fell to zero from $356,335 year over year, reflecting the timing of revenue under its MTLCA with GGBR. Earnings turned positive, driven mainly by a $1.89M unrealized gain on crypto assets, alongside debt-extinguishment and derivative fair-value gains and yield income.

: Expenses fell to $307,334 from $477,705, reflecting lower Orebits conversion-related costs and lower legal and management fees.
: The Company recorded a $1.89M unrealized gain on crypto assets in the quarter.
: Cash was $207,022 at September 30, 2026; cash used in operating activities was $986,055 for the nine months.
